constraints.description: Fund-level cap on total repurchases per month
constraints.conditions: Measured using aggregate NAV as of the end of the immediately preceding month
constraints.evidence_quote: The Repurchase Plan will be limited to no more than 2% of the Company's aggregate NAV per month (measured using the aggregate NAV as of the end of the immediately preceding month) and no more than 5% of the Company's aggregate NAV per calendar quarter (measured using the average aggregate NAV as of the end of the immediately preceding three months).
constraints.interpretation: Total repurchases across all investors are capped at this % of aggregate NAV (prior month-end) each month. A single household's fill depends on how much other investors request.

constraints.description: Fund-level cap on total repurchases per calendar quarter
constraints.conditions: Measured using average aggregate NAV as of the end of the immediately preceding three months
constraints.evidence_quote: The Repurchase Plan will be limited to no more than 2% of the Company's aggregate NAV per month (measured using the aggregate NAV as of the end of the immediately preceding month) and no more than 5% of the Company's aggregate NAV per calendar quarter (measured using the average aggregate NAV as of the end of the immediately preceding three months). For the avoidance of doubt, both of these limits are assessed during each month in a calendar quarter.
constraints.interpretation: Repurchases within a calendar quarter cannot exceed this % of average aggregate NAV; because both limits are assessed each month, the third month of a quarter can have less than the full monthly capacity remaining.

constraints.description: Oversubscribed months are filled pro rata
constraints.evidence_quote: In the event that the Company receives repurchase requests in excess of the 2% or 5% limits, then repurchase requests will be satisfied on a pro rata basis after the Company has repurchased all shares for which repurchase has been requested due to death, disability or divorce and other limited exceptions.
constraints.interpretation: When aggregate requests exceed available capacity, each request is filled in the same proportion (after death/disability/divorce and other limited exceptions). The fill % itself is NOT disclosed in advance - it depends on aggregate demand, which the simulator treats as a scenario assumption.

constraints.description: Board may repurchase fewer shares than requested, or none
constraints.evidence_quote: Should repurchase requests, in the board of directors' judgment, place an undue burden on its liquidity, adversely affect its operations or risk having an adverse impact on the Company as a whole, or should the board of directors otherwise determine that investing its liquid assets in real properties or other investments rather than repurchasing its shares is in the best interests of the Company as a whole, the Company's board of directors may determine to repurchase fewer shares than have been requested to be repurchased (including relative to the 2% monthly limit and 5% quarterly limit under the Repurchase Plan), or none at all.
constraints.interpretation: Discretionary: the board can repurchase below the 2%/5% limits or suspend entirely. No guaranteed fill rate exists; any stressed fill reduction must be an explicit scenario assumption.

constraints.description: Unfilled requests do not carry over automatically
constraints.evidence_quote: All unsatisfied repurchase requests must be resubmitted after the start of the next month or quarter, or upon the recommencement of the Repurchase Plan, as applicable.
constraints.interpretation: The unfilled portion of a request must be resubmitted next month/quarter; the simulator assumes the household resubmits its remaining target every month.

constraints.description: Shares held under one year are repurchased at a discount
constraints.evidence_quote: Repurchases will be made at the transaction price in effect on the Repurchase Date (which will generally be equal to our prior month's NAV per share), except that shares that have not been outstanding for at least one year will be repurchased at 98% of the transaction price (the "Early Repurchase Deduction") subject to certain limited exceptions.
constraints.interpretation: Quoted as a % of transaction price paid; deduction = 100% minus that figure. Applies only to shares outstanding less than one year.

constraints.description: Cash settles a few business days after the month-end repurchase date
constraints.evidence_quote: Settlements of share repurchases will generally be made within three business days of the Repurchase Date.
constraints.interpretation: Repurchases occur at month-end, so proceeds typically arrive early the following month. The simulator models a one-month settlement lag (modelling interpretation).
